plugin.name: Splinter Cell Pandora Tomorrow Fusion Fix
ResX.description: Use 0 to select the desktop resolution. Both dimensions must be set to override it.
ResY.description: Use 0 to select the desktop resolution. Both dimensions must be set to override it.
RawInputMouse.description: Read mouse movement without the original dropped events. Restart required.
RawInputMouseRawData.description: Use unaccelerated mouse movement. Restart required.
FMVWidescreenMode.description: Original 4:3 shows the movies as the game does, with their black bars. Fill screen enlarges them past the black bars around the picture until the picture fits the screen, without cutting anything off.
ScopeWidescreenMode.description: Move sniper scope textures toward the widescreen display edges.
HudAspectRatioConstraint.description: Auto puts the HUD at the screen edges. A ratio such as 4:3, 16:9 or 21:9 keeps it in a centered box; 4:3 is the original layout. Applies immediately.
PostProcessFixedScale.description: The game uses 512. 0 keeps it, 1 follows the screen width (rounded up to a multiple of 1024), other values set the size; larger sizes render night and thermal vision sharper.
GrainScale.description: Scale vision grain for the screen resolution. 1 uses the corrected 640x480 baseline; 0 keeps the original grain scale.
ShadowMapResolution.description: The game uses 256 and above. 0 keeps it, 1 uses the screen width (capped for stability), other values set the size; larger sizes give sharper shadows.
ReflectionsResolution.description: The game uses 256. 0 keeps it, 1 uses the screen width (capped for stability), other values set the size; larger sizes give sharper reflections.
LightDistanceMultiplier.description: Increase the distance at which dynamic lights and shadows remain active. 1 keeps the original distance.
SkipIntro.description: Skip the intro logos when the game starts.
SkipPressStartToContinue.description: Skip the initial Press Enter to Continue prompt.
CutsceneBorders.description: Framing of the cinematics, made for a 16:9 picture. Letterbox keeps the original bars on screens narrower than 16:9, Pillarbox puts bars at the sides of wider screens, Both does both. Off fills the screen. Applies immediately.
EnableConsole.description: Restore the developer console. Press the tilde key to open it.
EnableCheckpoints.description: Restore the checkpoint behavior from the Xbox release.
BloomResolutionMultiplier.description: Multiply the bloom render-target resolution. 0 keeps the original resolution; larger values increase GPU and memory use.
FPSLimit.description: Highest frame rate. 0 is unlimited, -1 follows the monitor's refresh rate. 60 is recommended: higher rates can affect AI and physics. Applies immediately.
GogglesLightColor.description: Color of Sam's suit and goggle lights and their glow. Original keeps the game's own lights; the others are the Ops Suit Light colors from Splinter Cell Blacklist. Restart required.

menu.title: Advanced Options
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language tag for Advanced Options and other plugins. auto follows the game language. Edit in the hub or CFG, then reopen Advanced Options.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a centered window, or borderless covering the monitor. Takes effect when the game starts. Alt+Enter switches fullscreen and the chosen window style.
FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the normal gameplay camera field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view, up to 150 degrees across. Scripted, aiming and gadget cameras keep their own framing. Applies immediately.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Restore this plugin's settings. Press twice to confirm.
menu.presethelp: Choose a preset and press twice to apply it to this plugin.
MouseSensitivity.description: Movement multiplier for raw mouse input. Applies immediately; presets preserve your choice.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Auto uses the full screen width. Set a ratio such as 4:3, 16:9 or 21:9 to keep the HUD in a centered area. Applies immediately.
menu.rawmouse.label: Raw mouse input
menu.rawmouse.help: Avoid dropped mouse events. Restart needed.
menu.rawdata.label: Raw mouse data
menu.rawsensitivity.label: Raw sensitivity
menu.rawsensitivity.help: Raw mouse speed. Live; presets keep it.
MAIN.ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the mouse cursor inside the game window while the game is active, so it can't move to another monitor. Applies immediately.
MAIN.CheckForUpdates.description: Once per start, asks fusionfix.io whether a newer version of the fix is out and tells you in the game. Off makes no network request.
MAIN.SaveLocation.description: Where profiles and saves are kept. Game Folder is the game's own Save folder, Documents uses Documents\My Games\Splinter Cell Pandora Tomorrow. Saves are not moved: copy the contents of the Save folder over to keep playing them. Restart required.
update.availablehub: {name} {version} is available. FusionFixHub opens when you close the game.
MAIN.PauseOnFocusLoss.description: Pauses the game and its sound while another window is active, as the original does. Off keeps the game running in the background in windowed and borderless modes. Applies immediately.
startup.unsupported: This version of Splinter Cell Pandora Tomorrow isn't supported. The Fusion Fix works with the retail release and the current Steam and Ubisoft Connect release. The game starts without the fix.
MAIN.GamepadIcons.description: Button names in prompts while a pad is used. Auto uses Xbox names; keyboard and mouse input restores keyboard prompts.
MAIN.GamepadCameraSpeed.description: How fast the right stick turns the camera and aims. Applies immediately.
MAIN.InvertGamepadY.description: Pushing the right stick up looks down. The game's own Invert Mouse option turns the pad around too. Applies immediately.
MAIN.Vibration.description: Lets the pad rumble with shots, explosions and hits. Applies immediately.
padPrompt.move.original: Use the Movement keys (W/S/A/D) to move. Use Accelerate key (mouse wheel up)  and Decelerate key (mouse wheel down) to adjust your speed.
padPrompt.move: Use the left stick to move. Push it further to move faster.
padPrompt.look.original: Move the mouse to look around.
padPrompt.look: Move the right stick to look around.
padPrompt.inventory.original: Use the mouse or arrows to select an item. To use the item, press the Fire key (left mouse button).
padPrompt.inventory: Use the stick to select an item. Press {fire} to use it.
padPrompt.pick.original: To release a pin, you must press the correct movement key (W or S or A or D by default).Once you hear and see the pin begin to move, press the same key repeatedly until it is released. Repeat until all pins are released.
padPrompt.pick: Move the left stick until you hear and see a pin move. Repeat that movement until the pin is released, then repeat for the other pins.
padPrompt.pickStart.original: Press the movement keys (W / S / A / D) until you hear and see the pin move. Press the same key repeatedly until it is released. Repeat until all pins are released.
padPrompt.pickStart: Move the left stick until you hear and see a pin move. Repeat that movement until the pin is released, then repeat for the other pins.
padPrompt.wall.original: To put your back to a wall, face the wall and press (Q). You will peek when you reach a corner.
padPrompt.wall: To put your back to a wall, face the wall and press {wall}. You will peek when you reach a corner.
